summary.intent: Resolve two review findings on PR #66 (monokl member blocks), clean up stale worktrees and merged trails, then start the next wave of feature and cleanup work.
summary.outcome: Fixed and resolved both #66 findings (commit 945e67f), removed 15 stale worktrees, closed 13 merged trails, and launched a four-track workflow (wave-3) stacked on #66. CI on #66 was still running at the end.

repo: PRs #64 and #65 are merged. #66 (change 38) is the open member-blocks PR, and wave-3 work is stacked on it.
A local check suite exists: tests (689 passing, 97.53% coverage), lint, deny, machete, drift and changesets.
A harness measures retrieval quality, currently at 56/59, 59/59 and 14/18. The 4 missed conceptual questions are the target of the ranking track.
Stale agent worktrees pile up and can be removed once merged, clean and unlocked. Locked worktrees, open-PR branches, worktrees with uncommitted changes and other jobs' directories must be kept.

Trails are tied to monokl changes and can be closed once all their changes are merged. The older process trails (194-199, 210, 235) were left open because it was unclear whether they are still needed.
workflow: Reproduce review findings before fixing them, then push without force and resolve each finding with the evidence recorded.
Dry-run cleanup scripts before deleting anything, so you can see what qualifies.
Run parallel agent tracks on disjoint files, and re-check harness numbers and CI yourself before calling agent-pushed work done.
Add a read-only adversarial review track that only reports findings it reproduced.
Accept ranking changes only if the harness proves they help.

friction: The arrow property snippet bug hid the match entirely: the signature showed `load = () =>` and the snippet was null.
The same-line statements bug returned the wrong block for `const a = 1; const needle = 2;`.
Deciding which old trails and worktrees were safe to remove needed manual inventory. About 24 worktrees were found, but only 15 qualified.
CI on #66 was still rerunning after the fix commit, so the fix was not yet confirmed there.
open_items: Confirm CI passes on #66 after commit 945e67f.
Wave-3 results are pending: members-pr2 (object-literal member rows), ranking (4 missed conceptual questions), docs-log (decision-log sections 28-30), and the read-only review of members-pr2.
Decide whether the older process trails (194-199, 210, 235) can be closed.
Remaining stale worktrees were kept deliberately: locked ones, the three open-PR branches, one with uncommitted changes, and other jobs' directories.
Re-verify harness numbers and CI for anything the wave-3 agents push.
